ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the line $l_{1}: y_{1}=ax+b$ and the line $l_{2}: y_{2}=mx$ are depicted in the same Cartesian coordinate system. What is the solution set of the inequality $mx<ax+b$ with respect to $x$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From the graph, it is known that the two lines intersect at the point $(-1,2)$, \\
when $x > -1$, $mx < ax+b$,\\
$\therefore$ the solution set is $\boxed{x > -1}$.
